text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rulership suffered a serious injury, so 
she was immediately treated in the 
infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... This is the worst... I really 
messed up...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
After taking all that time to draft a 
meticulous strategy, there's no way to 
carry it out like this...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Even if things don't go according to our 
original plan, we just have to do what we 
can...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's get back to training. The 
pain has subsided. I'm fine.
choice_data_list: No, you need strict bed rest.

...If I see it's too much, I'm stopping 
you right away.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's get back to training. The 
pain has subsided. I'm fine.
choice_data_list: No, you need strict bed rest.

...If I see it's too much, I'm stopping 
you right away.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Whyyyyyy...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I calmly listed the drawbacks to persuade 
her, explaining that pushing herself here 
could prolong her injury recovery and 
delay the plan even further.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Guh... That makes complete and utter 
sense...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Alright, alright... I just have to 
behave myself, right...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Aargh... I wish I could go back to the 
turn before getting injured and redo it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, I was worried about her 
mental state, but... Rulership ended up 
focusing entirely on treating her injury."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Understood, that works. Now, let's head 
over—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: —...Ouch!?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"No... I'm fine, really. I was just... 
being a little dramatic back there."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was obvious her injury was severe. 
Deciding that training was out of the 
question, I immediately made her rest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though I switched the menu to a lighter 
one, I kept a close eye on Rulership to 
make sure she didn't overexert herself.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: ...I'm fine. Looks like I can do this.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Even if unexpected trouble blocks my path, 
I immediately find a new way 
forward—that's who I am.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I can come up with as many optimal plans 
as you want. It's child's play for me, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rulership kept up as much training as she 
could... and eventually, she safely 
regained her form.
